root_cause: When _separable recursively evaluates a nested CompoundModel, its children become dependency matrices. For a right-hand matrix, _cstack replaces the entire dependency block with ones instead of preserving its contents. This turns independent linear-model inputs into false dependencies.

When lastmod is callable and items() is empty, Sitemap.get_latest_lastmod() calls max([]), which raises ValueError. Only TypeError is caught, so the exception propagates through the sitemap index view.

The TrueType branch of RendererPS.draw_text unconditionally appends curr_stream after glyph layout. An empty line yields no glyphs, so curr_stream remains None and stream becomes [None]. Unpacking that entry raises the reported TypeError. Text.draw forwards empty lines to the renderer.
model_patch:
--- a/lib/matplotlib/backends/backend_ps.py
+++ b/lib/matplotlib/backends/backend_ps.py
@@ -669,5 +669,6 @@
             # append the last entry
-            stream.append(curr_stream)
+            if curr_stream:
+                stream.append(curr_stream)
 
         self.set_color(*gc.get_rgb())
